recognize_zh: 高倍視野內有多顆巨核細胞：數顆成熟大型、細胞質粉紅豐富，另有數顆較小、核深染且細胞質較少的較不成熟形式，背景為密集的紅血球系前驅細胞，符合 ITP 的巨核細胞增生（含幼稚型增加）。
features: Multiple megakaryocytes per high-power field, including large mature forms with abundant pink granular cytoplasm
Some smaller megakaryocytes with dark, less lobulated nuclei and scant cytoplasm, consistent with immature forms
No micromegakaryocytes with single round nuclei or tight clusters clearly identified
Dense background of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and maturing granulocytes
Interspersed fat spaces; some section tearing artifact
describe_en: High-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows cellular marrow with numerous megakaryocytes, including large mature forms with abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and smaller forms with dark, less lobulated nuclei suggestive of immature megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are not tightly clustered, and no overt dysplastic micromegakaryocytes are identified. The background shows active erythropoiesis and granulopoiesis with interspersed adipocytes. Findings are consistent with increased megakaryopoiesis in response to peripheral platelet destruction, as in immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

ddx.vs: Dysplastic micromegakaryocytes are small with a single round nucleus and mature cytoplasm, and dysplasia involves other lineages, whereas here immature forms coexist with normal large megakaryocytes.
AMKL shows sheets of megakaryoblasts with fibrosis and high blast count on aspirate or CD61/CD42b IHC, not scattered maturing megakaryocytes.
ET megakaryocytes are predominantly giant and hyperlobated in clusters with thrombocytosis.
